content:
maria: Heads-up — targeting Tue May 26, 2026 at 10:00am PT for the release announcement + full rollout. Need one canonical changelog link, docs anchor, and rollout cadence confirmed by EOD. Also webinar + lead routing checks.

claire: We can do progressive ramp: canary 10:30am PT (5%), 10:45am PT 50%, 10:00am PT 100% (timing aligns with post). Ops will watch p50/p95 and error-rate.

nate: Docs PR live: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/712 — includes migration notes and API snippet. Waiting on the short perf blurb and a rollback sentence for the docs.

maria: For the marketing headline we need 1 snappy sentence and one supporting stat for the changelog. Keep it tight for social copy.

nate: Draft for copy: "New batching + cache-warm reduces median gen latency by ~23% and cuts per-1k token cost by ~21%." I'll confirm exacts with the benchmark and paste numbers here.

ops-bot: Release window scheduled: 2026-05-26T17:30:00Z -> 2026-05-26T18:20:00Z (canary -> ramp). Runbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-05-26. Monitor channel: #release-watch.

claire: Webinar is Wed 8:30am PT — product + eng panel. Need a 90s perf clip and a one-slide summary for the email. Who records the clip?

nate: I can record a terminal demo and a quick perf sample and upload to the shared drive by tomorrow AM. Link to upload: https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/media.

maria: Salesops wants inbound signups auto-tagged for routing. salesops — what's the exact CRM tag and SLA?

salesops: Use tag = "may_release_2026". SLA: 48-hour lead response. Please ensure webinar and site forms add this hidden tag and the form handler posts the tag to CRM.

claire: Example webhook payload for CRM:

```json
{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "name": "Pat Lead",
  "tags": ["may_release_2026", "webinar_signup"],
  "source": "release_banner"
}
```

Well also add a UTMs to the email CTA so GA tracks it.

maria: Changelog owner? Need a single permalink we can point to in the blog post and social.

nate: Changelog PR created: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/158 — will add the final perf sentence + legal blurb. Ping me when legal clears.

maria: Ops roll criteria? When do we hold or rollback?

claire: Hold if p50 > 2x baseline or if error rate >1% sustained for 5 minutes. Rollback plan: auto-fallback to stable and page #incidents. Rollback runbook step is in the release runbook.

pr-bot: Preflight checklist: changelog PR present, docs PR present, webinar scheduled, lead-tag configured, runbook attached. Missing: final perf sentence in docs, legal review.

nate: Bench jobs finished: median 128ms -> 98ms; p95 410ms -> 315ms; cost per 1k tokens $0.46 -> $0.36. Dropping these exact numbers into the docs PR now.

maria: Perfect — marketing headline will use the median latency stat. Proposed publish cadence: 10:00am PT blog post, 10:05am social, 10:15am email. Marketing will gate send until ops gives green at 10:00am PT.

claire: Canary will start in EU first then US. If canary is clean at 10:00am PT we ramp to 100% and give green. If not, we fail back and hold the publish.

salesops: Confirmed: CRM webhook endpoint ready. Please send a test payload once the form change is live so we can verify tag ingestion.

nate: Uploaded perf clip: https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/media/perf-demo-may26.mp4. Docs anchor published: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-05-26.

ops-bot: Canary started: EU region. Deploy logs: https://deploys.redwood.ai/logs/98123.

maria: Copy. Waiting for changelog merge + legal sign-off and the test lead payload. Ping thread when ready.

nate: Changelog merged: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/158/merge — published and points to docs anchor. Legal cleared.

maria: Got it. Marketing is queueing the email and social. Holding final send until ops posts green in #release-watch.

ops-bot: Rollout complete: 100% traffic. Post-deploy checks OK. All monitors nominal.

maria: Publishing now. Sending final recap email to stakeholders. Thanks everyone — great coordination!
